changes: Era changed from VS to ŚS: the samvatsara name Vyaya fits ŚS 1628 = 1706/07 CE exactly (Vyaya, 20th Jovian year), whereas VS 1628 (1571/72 CE) would fall in Prajāpati/Aṅgiras. ce_approx changed from 1572 to 1707 (Māgha kṛṣṇa ≈ Jan/Feb 1707).
Removed the wrote_for relation Murāri→Sadānanda. The colophon only says Murāri wrote the copy and Sadānanda owns it; it does not say the copy was made for him, and the ownership note could be later.
Lowered Kṛṣṇa Jośī to low confidence and expanded the note on his unclear role.

notes: The colophon says only 'samvat', which normally means VS. However, the samvatsara name Vyaya matches ŚS 1628 (1706/07 CE) and does not match VS 1628 (1571/72 CE), so I read the era as Śaka. The weekday has not been checked. 'pustakamadaḥ' = pustakam adaḥ, meaning 'this book is Sadānanda's'. 'śrīkṛṣṇa jośī' follows the ownership phrase with no syntax linking it, so his role is unclear. He could be a second owner, Sadānanda's father or family name (Sadānanda [son of] Kṛṣṇa Jośī), or someone who added a later note. Ascribing the Uttaragītā to Gauḍapāda is traditional. The catalogue gives the scribe's name as Murārī; the manuscript has 'murarīna', which I normalised to Murāri.
